event.text: Please arrange to be seen in person today for a mental health assessment (urgent care, your clinician, or a crisis service). If you have any intent or a plan to harm yourself now, or feel unable to keep yourself safe, call 911 or go to the nearest emergency department right away. Weeks of hopelessness with thoughts that others would be better off without you need a same-day safety assessment. If no service can assess you today, go to an emergency department rather than waiting for a reply; you can call or text 988 for support while arranging care. I recommend a Counsel clinician also review this thread today.
